text: The thiosulfate ion, S O , is unstable in the presence of acid. The following reaction occurs.
S O (aq) + 2H (aq) → S(s) + SO (aq) + H O(l)
The rate of this reaction can be measured by timing how long it takes for the solid sulfur that is
formed to make the mixture too cloudy to see through.
Throughout these experiments care must be taken to avoid inhaling any SO that is produced.
It is very important that as soon as each experiment is complete, the contents of the beaker
are emptied into the quenching bath and the beaker is rinsed thoroughly.
